run_psro_experiment: run the prompt-space response oracle algorithm on a chat game to explore message tones
estimate_payoff_tensor: estimate the payoff tensor by simulating dialogues between fixed-tone policies
score_candidate_responses: score candidate prompt responses against background policies to find best responses
compute_sym_eq: compute the symmetric equilibrium strategy using asymmetric replicator dynamics
symmetrize_payoff_tensor: symmetrize a payoff tensor by averaging over all player strategy permutations
